meta.name: clean-architecture
meta.description: Structure software around the Dependency Rule: source code dependencies point inward from frameworks to use cases to entities. Use when the user mentions "architecture layers", "dependency rule", "ports and adapters (hexagonal)", "onion architecture", "screaming architecture", "where should business logic go", "decouple from the database", "swap the framework without a rewrite", or "keep business rules independent". Also trigger when deciding which layer code belongs in, isolating core logic from infrastructure, defining module boundaries, or debating whether the framework should call your code or the reverse. Covers component principles, boundaries, and SOLID. For code-level quality, see clean-code. For domain modeling, see domain-driven-design.

copy.tagline: 按依赖规则组织软件架构，分离业务逻辑与基础设施
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在设计或重构分层架构，想让业务逻辑独立于框架和数据库
copy.tagline_en: Structure software by the Dependency Rule, decoupling business logic from infrastructure

howto.what: Claude 会帮你按照依赖规则组织软件架构，确保业务逻辑独立于框架、数据库等外部细节。它会分析你的代码分层，指出依赖方向是否正确，并给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“架构分层”、“依赖规则”、“六边形架构”等关键词，或询问业务逻辑应该放在哪里、如何解耦数据库时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个项目的依赖方向是否正确。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码并指出依赖违规处。

say.text: 如何将业务逻辑与数据库解耦？
say.note: Claude 会解释端口和适配器模式。

say.text: 这个控制器里是否混入了业务规则？
say.note: Claude 会检查并建议将逻辑移到用例层。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you structure software around the Dependency Rule, ensuring business logic is independent of frameworks, databases, and external details. It analyzes your code layers, identifies dependency direction issues, and suggests fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "architecture layers", "dependency rule", "hexagonal architecture", or ask where business logic should go or how to decouple from the database.

say_en.text: Check if the dependency direction in this project is correct.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze code and point out violations.

say_en.text: How do I decouple business logic from the database?
say_en.note: Claude explains ports and adapters pattern.

say_en.text: Does this controller contain business rules?
say_en.note: Claude checks and suggests moving logic to use cases.
